testCase:
F-03: The link appears after the form
Goal: Download the report for the last 30 days as a CSV file.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/f-03/
STEP 2: Choose "Last 30 days" in "Date range"
STEP 3: Choose "CSV" in "Format"
STEP 4: Click "Generate report"
STEP 5: Click "Download report"
STEP 6: Verify "Saved report-last-30-days.csv" is visible
STEP 7: Verify the downloaded file "report-last-30-days.csv" contains the line "range,last-30-days"

plan.title: F-03: Download last 30 days CSV report

steps.note: Generate the report and expose its download link.
Verify the downloaded filename and expected reporting-range content.

reasoning: This test verifies that generating a CSV report for the last 30 days makes it downloadable and produces the expected file content. The plan follows the form and download flow, then checks the visible save confirmation and downloaded CSV.
